meta.source: Yahoo Finance adjusted daily bars, frozen 2026-09-26
meta.method: For each side and rank, rebuild the locked historical level at each eligible past session without future data. Keep cases whose level gap is within 1.5 percentage points of today’s gap. Count a touch when the published level is reached within the next 63 sessions. Display only the most recent 10 qualifying cases, with at least 8 required.
